name: KaibanJS
description: Builds multi-agent systems in JavaScript with role-based agents, tasks, and teams that run on a Kanban-style board, for JavaScript and TypeScript developers.

skills.name: Role-Based Agents
skills.description: Defines agents with a name, role, goal, and background that loop on tasks until they reach a final answer.

skills.name: Teams and Tasks
skills.description: Coordinates agents in a team that passes task results along and marks deliverables.

skills.name: Tool Integration
skills.description: Equips agents with tools such as web search to act beyond text generation.

skills.name: Workflow-Driven Agent
skills.description: Runs a predefined workflow inside an agent for deterministic multi-step execution.
